title: Register the accepted switch_pt executor in the v2 vocabulary

evidence.fact: The accepted overlay supplies a working switch_pt ExecuteAbilityEffect dispatcher for self, bare target creature, and each creature; its scope intentionally excluded the v2 registry.
The parser emits only effects discovered from backend/cards/registry.go plus registry_*.go; without a registered switch_pt primitive, a correct Map tuple remains an honest miss.
The frozen literal requires new primitives through a registry_*.go init function using regEffect, not a tail edit.

The existing v2 spell EffectAtom sequence path forwards an effect name, value, and target to the shared ability-effect executor; this ticket must prove registration is compatible with that existing path, not add a second converter route.

required_behavior: Add exactly one switch_pt v2 Primitive through backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go using the existing regEffect convention.
Its Executor evidence must name the accepted ExecuteAbilityEffect switch_pt dispatcher, and its ShapeTest must name the new discriminating test.

Add one backend/cards shape test proving switch_pt is registered and a spell EffectAtom sequence carrying a bare creature target reaches the existing shared execution path. The parent Engine test remains authority for Layer-7e behavior.
Do not edit parser, converter, frozen registry literal, or backend/game. Do not add any new primitive besides switch_pt.
gates: git status --porcelain adds or changes only backend/cards/registry_switch_pt.go and backend/cards/shape_switch_pt_test.go

execution.selection_reason: This is a small but cross-boundary Engine registration proof. Claude receives the accepted parent overlays and exact registry/converter anchors; it may make one bounded NEED request but cannot commit, push, deploy, or mutate live tickets.

on_failure: Record an immutable receipt. A request to change parser, converter, or Layer-7e execution is a separate TicketSpec.
